title: DENR cites public role after turnover of rescued wildlife in Cotabato

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has highlighted the public’s role in wildlife conservation after two Cotabato residents voluntarily turned over 12 rescued wildlife species to its provincial office on Sept. 10. “The recovery highlights growing community initiative and adherence to Republic Act (RA) No. 9147, also known as the Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act, and its implementing rules and regulations,” the DENR said in a news release on Wednesday. “After learning that the collection, possession, transport, and keeping of wildlife are strictly regulated, the residents coordinated directly with environmental authorities.” READ: DENR: 394 illegally traded […]...
